ayahs.translation_en: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

clauses.en: Blessed is He in whose hand is the dominion,
and He is capable of all things.

ayahs.translation_en: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -

clauses.en: The One who created death and life
to test you as to which of you is best in deed,
and He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.

ayahs.translation_en: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?

clauses.en: The One who created seven heavens in layers.
You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency.

phrases.en: in the creation of the Most Merciful

clauses.en: So return your vision.
Do you see any breaks?

ayahs.translation_en: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

clauses.en: Then return your vision twice more.
Your vision will return to you humbled, and it is exhausted.

phrases.en: Your vision will return to you

ayahs.translation_en: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars] and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

clauses.en: And indeed We adorned the lowest heaven with lamps
and made them things to be thrown at the devils,
and We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

ayahs.translation_en: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

clauses.en: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell,
and wretched is the destination.

ayahs.translation_en: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.

clauses.en: When they are thrown into it,
they hear from it a harsh roar
while it boils.

ayahs.translation_en: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

clauses.en: It almost bursts with rage.
Every time a group is thrown into it,

phrases.en: a group is thrown into it,

clauses.en: its keepers ask them,
“Did there not come to you a warner?”

ayahs.translation_en: They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allāh has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"

clauses.en: They will say, “Yes,
a warner did come to us,

phrases.en: a warner did come to us,

clauses.en: but we denied and said,
‘Allah has not sent down anything.
You are only in great error.’”

ayahs.translation_en: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

clauses.en: And they will say,
“If only we had been listening or reasoning,
we would not have been among the companions of the Blaze.”

phrases.en: among the companions of the Blaze.”

ayahs.translation_en: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

clauses.en: So they admit their sin;
away with the companions of the Blaze!

ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

clauses.en: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen
will have forgiveness and a great reward.

ayahs.translation_en: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

clauses.en: And conceal your speech or declare it openly;
Indeed, He is All-Knowing of what lies within the breasts.

phrases.en: of what lies within the breasts.

ayahs.translation_en: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Aware?

clauses.en: Would the One who created not know?

phrases.en: Would the One who created not know?

clauses.en: And He is the Subtle, the All-Aware.

ayahs.translation_en: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

clauses.en: He is the One who
made the earth manageable for you,
so walk through its regions
and eat from His provision;
and to Him is the resurrection.

ayahs.translation_en: Do you feel secure that He who is above would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?

clauses.en: Do you feel secure that He who is in the heaven

phrases.en: that He who is in the heaven

clauses.en: would not cause the earth to swallow you,

phrases.en: would not cause the earth to swallow you,

clauses.en: and suddenly it sways?

ayahs.translation_en: Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.

clauses.en: Or do you feel secure that He who is in the heaven

phrases.en: that He who is in the heaven

clauses.en: would not send against you a storm of stones?
So you will soon know how terrible My warning was.

ayahs.translation_en: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

clauses.en: And indeed those who came before them denied,

phrases.en: those who came before them denied,

clauses.en: and how terrible My reproach was!

ayahs.translation_en: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.

clauses.en: Have they not seen the birds above them, spreading their wings and folding them in?
None holds them up except the Most Merciful.
Indeed, He is All-Seeing over everything.

ayahs.translation_en: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.

clauses.en: Or who is this one who is an army for you,

phrases.en: Or who is this one who

clauses.en: to help you besides the Most Merciful?
The disbelievers are only in delusion.

ayahs.translation_en: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

clauses.en: Or who is this one who could provide for you

phrases.en: Or who is this one who

clauses.en: if He withheld His provision?
Rather, they persist in arrogance and aversion.

ayahs.translation_en: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

clauses.en: Is the one who walks bent over on his face
better guided,
or the one who walks upright on a straight path?

ayahs.translation_en: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful."

clauses.en: Say, “He is the One who created you
and made for you hearing, sight, and hearts;
how little you give thanks!”

ayahs.translation_en: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

clauses.en: Say, “He is the One who dispersed you throughout the earth,
and to Him you will be gathered.”

ayahs.translation_en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

clauses.en: And they say, “When is this promise,
if you are truthful?”

ayahs.translation_en: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."

clauses.en: Say, “The knowledge is only with Allah,
and I am only a clear warner.”

ayahs.translation_en: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."

clauses.en: But when they see it close at hand,
the faces of those who disbelieved will be distressed,

phrases.en: the faces of those who disbelieved will be distressed,

clauses.en: and it will be said, “This is what you used to call for.”

ayahs.translation_en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered: whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

clauses.en: Say, “Have you considered:
if Allah were to destroy me and those with me,
or have mercy on us,
who then can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?”

ayahs.translation_en: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."

clauses.en: Say, “He is the Most Merciful; we believe in Him,
and upon Him we rely.
So you will soon know who it is that is in clear error.”

ayahs.translation_en: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"

clauses.en: Say, “Have you considered:
if your water were to sink away,

phrases.en: your water were to sink away,

clauses.en: who then could bring you flowing water?”
